model.query:
let _config = AnomalySubscriptions | summarize bin_size=max(totime(bin_size)), time_window=max(totime(time_window));
let _bin = toscalar(_config | project bin_size);
let _window = toscalar(_config | project time_window);
let _threshold = toscalar(AnomalySubscriptions | summarize max(threshold));
OTELTraces
| where StartTime > ago(_window)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName in (AnomalySubscriptions | project anomality)
| make-series SpanCount = count() default=0 on StartTime from bin(ago(_window), _bin) to bin(now(), _bin) - _bin * 3 step _bin by ServiceName
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(SpanCount, _threshold, -1, 'linefit')
| mv-expand StartTime to typeof(datetime), SpanCount to typeof(long), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(real), baseline to typeof(real)
| where SpanCount > 0 and anomalies != 0 and StartTime > ago(25m)
| join kind=inner AnomalySubscriptions on $left.ServiceName == $right.anomality
| summarize arg_max(abs(score), anomalies, SpanCount, StartTime, threshold, bin_size, time_window) by ServiceName, mail
| extend Direction = iff(anomalies > 0, "spike", "drop")
| project Timestamp = now(), ServiceName, mail, Direction, Threshold = tostring(threshold), BinSize = tostring(bin_size), TimeWindow = tostring(time_window), Value = abs(score)
